definition.text: Citizen; wakeful. (1.) A Tekoite, one of David’s thirty warriors (2 Sam. 23:26). (2.) An Ithrite, also one of David’s heroes (2 Sam. 23:38). (3.) A Jairite and priest, a royal chaplain (2 Sam. 20:26) or confidential adviser (comp. 2 Sam. 8:18; 1 Chr. 18:17).

lemmas.gloss: Ira, the name of three Israelites
a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah
a Jithrite or descendant of Jether
Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jer
